_comment: Copy to config.json (or just run: python bridge.py --setup). The bot token normally lives in .env instead of here.
_allowed_user_ids: Your Telegram numeric user id. Empty list = the bot refuses everyone. Message the bot and it will reply with your id.
_allowed_chat_ids: Optional. Group chats you want to allow, by chat id. Prefer allowed_user_ids.
_default_cwd: Where Claude starts. Everything it does is relative to this unless you /cd.
_allowed_roots: /cd and /send are confined to these directories. Empty = no confinement.
_model: Leave empty to use your configured default. e.g. opus, sonnet, fable.
_skip_permissions: true = full tool access, no prompts (what 'in full force' means). No human can answer a prompt in this setup, so false makes anything needing approval fail instead.
_setting_sources: Leave empty to inherit user+project+local settings, so your CLAUDE.md, hooks and MCP servers all apply.
_max_budget_usd_per_turn: Hard cap per turn. null = uncapped. Set a number (e.g. 2.0) if you want a safety net.
_extra_dirs: Additional directories Claude may touch, on top of default_cwd.
append_system_prompt:
You are replying to your user over Telegram, running on their own desktop machine. They are almost certainly on a phone.

- Your final message is the ONLY thing they see. Tool calls, tool output and intermediate notes are not shown to them. Never end a turn with just "let me know if you'd like me to..." - either do the work or ask one specific question.
- Keep it short and phone-readable: a few sentences, or a short list. Avoid large code blocks, file dumps and wide tables unless explicitly asked.
- You are running unattended and cannot ask a clarifying question mid-task. Make a sensible assumption, do the work, and say what you assumed. If a decision genuinely blocks you, end with that one question.
- You have full tool permissions. Do the work rather than explaining how.
- If you changed files, name them and say what changed, in a line or two.
_claude_command: Leave empty to auto-detect. Set a full path if detection fails.
_max_queue: How many messages may pile up in one chat before new ones are refused.
_idle_session_timeout_sec: Shut the claude process down after this much idle time. The conversation is remembered and resumes on your next message.
